instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Salt extraction and refining facility producing 25,000 tons of industrial and food-grade salt annually from marine evaporation pans. Weather-dependent production cycles create forecasting challenges. Evaluating brine concentration sensors and automated crystallization monitoring. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.

input.changes_since_last: Restructured leadership team. 8 legacy processes automated. Exploring new revenue streams.

opportunities.title: Systematic Operational Cost Driver Mapping and Automation (Process Mining)
opportunities.rationale: The core mandate is improving EBITDA margins by 500 bps. Since 8 processes have already been automated, the next logical step is to systematically map high-cost manual processes using process mining techniques. This moves beyond simple automation to identify systemic bottlenecks and redundant steps across the operational value chain.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional 'Efficiency Czar' team reporting directly to the new leadership structure.
Implement process mining tools (e.g., Celonis) on 3 critical, manual workflows identified by finance/operations.
Conduct stakeholder interviews focused specifically on points of friction and exception handling in current processes.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in Mean Time to Complete (MTTC) for targeted manual processes by 20% within 9 months.
milestones: Top 5 cost bottlenecks identified and prioritized (Month 4)
Automation roadmap v2.0, including investment size (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Developing Predictive Yield and Resource Consumption Models
opportunities.rationale: The reliance on weather-dependent cycles creates forecasting risk. Integrating new data sources, such as the proposed brine concentration sensors and operational sensor data, into a predictive model will stabilize yield forecasting and improve resource allocation planning, directly supporting cost reduction goals.

first_actions: Integrate IoT/sensor data feeds (brine concentration, temperature) into the existing data warehouse structure.
Develop baseline correlation models linking input variables (weather, sensor readings) to crystallized yield. This must be validated against historical manual records.
Pilot a dashboard view allowing operations managers to visualize predicted output variance 30 days in advance.
resources_needed: Data Scientist specializing in time-series analysis
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unexpected operational downtime related to poor forecasting by 15%.
milestones: Data ingestion pipeline functional and tested (Month 3)
Initial predictive model v1.0 deployed for shadow testing (Month 6)
Model integrated into daily decision-making routine (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Establish a clear, quantitative ROI gateway for all innovation proposals. Projects must demonstrate projected cost savings or revenue lift within the 12-month window.
Formalize 'Knowledge Transfer' modules. Document and socialize the best practices derived from the 8 automated legacy processes to mitigate talent risk and ensure institutional knowledge capture.
Initiate a formal review of the current digital architecture to identify necessary API layers and middleware required for connecting newly acquired sensor data (IoT) with legacy operational systems.

key_weaknesses: Strategic Tension: Difficulty balancing immediate, critical efficiency improvements (OPEX focus) versus the long-term investment required for digital transformation.
Cultural Resistance to Deep Process Change: Operational staff may be comfortable with existing manual workflows, slowing down adoption of highly optimized automated processes.
Fragmented Data Ownership: While data exists in various pockets (sensors, spreadsheets, legacy systems), a single source of truth and clear ownership structure remains underdeveloped.

improvements: Structural improvements via leadership restructuring have cleared decision-making bottlenecks.
Tangible operational gains realized through the automation of 8 key legacy processes, providing immediate cost visibility and process standardization.
The commitment to improving EBITDA margins has successfully elevated data-driven planning (NPS survey).
persistent_gaps: The link between newly automated 'efficiency' gains and the broader 'strategic' goals of new revenue streams is not yet quantified or integrated into project scoring.
Requires stronger integration between OT/IoT data streams and IT analytical tools to enable predictive modeling.
achieved_milestones: Successfully automated 8 core, repetitive operational processes (validated by process mapping).
Established a formal quarterly review cycle via the internal venture studio model.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant structural improvements and operational automation successes (8 processes) have increased execution capacity and data maturity, allowing the shift from 'process definition' to 'optimization and prediction'.
